recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Any future correction to driver-license identifier registry content should be handled in HL7 Terminology or TSMG-managed registry content, not by reintroducing the old core driver-license list.
issue_request: FHIR-7535 was a Published/Persuasive Vocabulary change request from the 2015May core ballot asking to change the driver's license entries on the terminology systems page to NamingSystem-based handling.
initial_application: Git commit 6156a02e859af9a1022dd9e52ae7ea8d0e0ffa0a, the git-svn import of svn revision 5712 cited by Jira, removed source/valueset/valueset-systems.xml, added source/identifier-registry.html and source/namingsystem/namingsystem-registry.xml, redirected datatypes.html identifier guidance, and reduced terminologies-systems.html to code-system content.
additional_context: Later FHIR-37889 and FHIR-40117 work removed the core NamingSystem registry bundles because detailed registry content is maintained in HL7 Terminology. The combined branch already contains those later issue-reconcile commits, so restoring driver-license entries in core would conflict with current registry ownership.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Current source separates code systems from identifier systems, points shared identifier systems to identifier-registry.html, HL7 Terminology, NamingSystem, and TSMG policy, and no longer contains the old driver-license value set registry content.

related_jiras.note: Removed core NamingSystem registry/terminology bundles that had superseded the old named systems value set approach.
Confirmed that the empty core namingsystem-registry.xml artifact left after FHIR-37889 should not remain in current source.
